---
title: "Dr. Smith appointed Chair of the Department of Pharmaceutical Outcomes & Policy"
author: "Steven M. Smith"
date: "2024-09-12"
categories: [news]
image: "Steve-Smith.jpg"
---

Dr. Smith was appointed Chair of the [Department of Pharmaceutical Outcomes & Policy](https://pop.pharmacy.ufl.edu) at the University of Florida. He previously served as interim chair of the department for the past 15 months.

The College of Pharmacy has a more substantive write-up, which can be found [here](https://pharmacy.ufl.edu/2024/09/12/dr-steve-smith-appointed-chair-of-the-department-of-pharmaceutical-outcomes-and-policy/).
